name: Rastoke
description: Where the Slunjčica drops into the Korana in a set of waterfalls, with a village built directly on top of them — mill houses straddling the channels, water running under the floors. It is what Plitvice looks like with people living in it.
getting: Fifteen minutes from Plitvice's northern entrance on the D1, so it works as the stop on the way out. Small paid entry to the mill village.
